items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, а҃. і҆рмо́съ: Трїста́ты крѣ̑пкїѧ, рожде́йса ѿ дв҃ы, безстра́стїа во глубинѣ̀, дꙋ́ши трїча́стное потопѝ молю́ся, да тебѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ въ тѵмпа́нѣ, во ᲂу҆мерщвле́нїи тѣлесѐ побѣ́дное воспою̀ пѣ́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* O Thou Who wast born of the Virgin, drown, I pray Thee, the tripartite power of my soul in the depth of dispassion, even as Thou didst the mighty captains of old, that unto Thee as on a timbrel, through the mortification of the body, I may sing a triumphal hymn.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дво́ице свѣтови́днаѧ мꙋ́рыхъ безсре́бренникъ, трⷪ҇цѣ чтⷭ҇нѣй со всѣ́ми и҆збра́нными предстоя́щи моли́ся, па́мѧть твою̀ свѣтоно́снꙋю тво́рѧщымъ, просвѣти́тисѧ дх҃а бж҃твенными свѣ́тлостьми.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* O radiant pair of wise unmercenaries, as you stand before the honored Trinity with all the chosen, pray that those who keep your light-bearing memory may be enlightened with the divine brightness of the Spirit.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Превысо́цы ᲂу҆мо́мъ сꙋ́щихъ въ веще́хъ ꙗ҆ви́вшеся, невеще́ственна блиста́нїа дх҃а мꙋ́рїи прїѧ́сте ст҃і́и. Тѣ́мже тмꙋ̀ недꙋ́гѡвъ разрѣша́ете всегда̀, посѣще́нїи бж҃твенными безсре́бренницы.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Shown forth as exalted in mind above material things, O wise and holy ones, you received the immaterial radiance of the Spirit. Therefore, by your divine visitations, O unmercenaries, you ever dispel the darkness of diseases.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Недрема́нно дꙋше́вное стѧжа́вше ѻ҆́ко, ко и҆сполне́нїю бж҃їю, бж҃твенныхъ за́повѣдей, спѧ́щыѧ въ недꙋ́зѣхъ сла́внїи, къ добро́мꙋ здра́вїю возбужда́ете бл[а]года́тїю, мл[с]ти́вїи бг҃оно́снїи безсре́бренницы.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having acquired an unsleeping eye of the soul toward the divine fulfillment of God's commandments, O glorious, merciful, and God-bearing unmercenaries, by grace you awaken unto good health those sleeping in infirmities.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Сп҃са и҆ бг҃а, ѿ чⷭ҇тыхъ твои́хъ крове́й, воплоти́ла є҆сѝ чⷭ҇таѧ, показа́вшаго на́мъ врачѝ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ пречⷭ҇таѧ, спаси́тєльны и҆ те́плы застꙋ́пники, че́стныѧ безсре́бренники, дх҃омъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* From thy pure blood, O pure one, thou didst incarnate the Savior and God, Who through the Spirit showed forth unto us the honored unmercenaries as physicians for our souls, O most pure one, and as saving and fervent protectors.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, и҃. Подо́бенъ: Премꙋ́дрости: И҆сцѣле́нїй да́тели и҆ чꙋдотво́рцы, и҆ чꙋде́съ свѣти́льники свѣтопрїе́мнїи всѣ̑мъ ꙗ҆ви́стеся, дх҃о́вною бл҃гтїю: стра́стный бо пла́мень вѣ́рою прохлажда́ете, и҆ вѣ́рнымъ въ не́й смы́слъ согрѣва́ете. Тѣ́мъ враче́бство дꙋше́вное стѧжа́вше бж҃твеннꙋю це́рковь ва́шꙋ, къ не́йже прибѣга́юще вопїе́мъ: бг҃оно́сцы безсре́бренницы, моли́те Хр[іс]та̀ Хр[іс]та̀ Бг҃а, согрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти, пра́зднꙋющымъ любо́вїю ст҃ꙋ́ю па́мѧть ва́шꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Givers of healings and wonderworkers, you have appeared unto all as light-receiving lamps of wonders through spiritual grace; for by faith you cool the flame of passions and warm the understanding of the faithful therein. Therefore, having acquired your divine church as a medicine for souls, fleeing unto it we cry: O God-bearing unmercenaries, pray to Christ God, to grant remission of transgressions unto those who celebrate your holy memory with love.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆сцѣле́нїй зари̑, сꙋ́щымъ на землѝ возсїѧ́юще, * бж҃е́ственнїи чꙋдотво́рцы, * ꙗ҆́вѣ ѿгонѧ́ете человѣ́кѡвъ недꙋ́ги, вои́стиннꙋ незаходи́маго сл҃нца въ себѣ̀ стѧжа́вше, * Хр[іс]та̀ Бг҃а на́шего. Тѣ́мже досто́йнѡ соше́дшесѧ, * почита́емъ сла́внꙋю ст҃і́и и҆ чⷭ҇тнꙋю ва́шꙋ па́мѧть, бг҃оно́снїи безсре́бренницы. Моли́те Хр[іс]та̀ Бг҃а, грѣхѡ́въ ѡ҆ставле́нїе пода́ти, чтꙋ́щымъ любо́вїю ст҃ꙋ́ю па́мѧть ва́шꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Shedding the rays of healings upon those on earth, O divine wonderworkers, you manifestly drive away the ailments of men, having truly acquired within yourselves the unwaning Sun, Christ our God. Therefore, having worthily assembled, we honor your glorious and precious memory, O holy ones, God-bearing unmercenaries. Pray to Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who honor your holy memory with love.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ дв҃ꙋ и҆ є҆ди́нꙋ въ жена́хъ, * тѧ̀ безъ сѣ́мене ро́ждшꙋю Бг҃а пло́тїю, всѝ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ ро́ди чл҃вѣ́честїи: ѻ҆́гнь бо всели́сѧ въ тѧ̀ бж҃тва̀, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ мл҃нца млеко́мъ пита́еши зижди́телѧ и҆ Гдⷭ҇а. Тѣ́мъ а҆́гг҃льскїй и҆ чл҃вѣ́ческїй ро́дъ, досто́йнѡ сла́вимъ прест҃о́е ржⷭ҇тво̀ твоѐ, и҆ согла́снѡ вопїе́мъ тѝ: молѝ Хр[іс]та̀ Бг҃а, согрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти, покланѧ́ющымсѧ вѣ́рою прест҃о́мꙋ ржⷭ҇твꙋ твоемꙋ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: As the Virgin and the only one among women who without seed bare God in the flesh, all human generations call thee blessed; for the fire of the Godhead dwelt in thee, and as an infant thou didst nourish the Creator and Lord with milk. Therefore we, both the angelic and human race, worthily glorify thy most holy childbearing, and with one accord cry unto thee: Pray to Christ God to grant remission of transgressions unto those who venerate thy most holy childbearing in faith.

items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding her Lamb and Shepherd and Deliverer upon the Cross, the ewe-lamb cried out weeping, and bitterly lamenting she exclaimed: "The world indeed rejoices, having received deliverance through Thee, but my womb burns within me as I behold Thy crucifixion, which Thou endurest through the tender compassion of Thy mercy, O longsuffering Lord. O abyss of mercy and inexhaustible fountain, have compassion and grant remission of transgressions unto those who in faith hymn Thy divine passions!"

Beholding her Lamb and Shepherd and Deliverer upon the Cross, the ewe-lamb cried out weeping, and bitterly lamenting she exclaimed: "The world indeed rejoices, having received deliverance through Thee, but my womb burns within me as I behold Thy crucifixion, which Thou endurest through the tender compassion of Thy mercy, O longsuffering Lord. O abyss of mercy and inexhaustible fountain, have compassion and grant remission of transgressions unto those who in faith hymn Thy divine passions!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ст҃ъ є҆ди́нъ є҆сѝ, прославлѧ́ѧ ст҃ы̑ѧ твоѧ̑: мі́ръ бо тѣ́хъ ра́ди, и҆збавлѧ́еши ѿ бѣ́дъ, и҆ просвѣща́еши зовꙋ́щымъ: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ въ хра́мѣ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou alone art holy, Who glorifiest Thy saints; for for their sake Thou deliverest the world from misfortunes, and enlightenest those who cry: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Же́злъ и҆з̾ ко́рене і҆ессе́ева ты̀ прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ, цвѣ́та Хр[іс]та̀ и҆зрасти́вши Мр҃і́е: ꙗ҆́кѡ цвѣ́тцы чꙋдесы̀ ᲂу҆краси́вшаго, своѧ̑ безсре́бренники ᲂу҆го́дныѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou didst bud forth as a rod from the root of Jesse, O Mary, having blossomed forth the Flower, Christ, Who as flowers adorned His pleasing servants, the unmercenaries, with wonders.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ко́зни всѧ́кїѧ ꙗ҆ви́стеся вра́жїѧ ѕло́бы ст҃і́и, бж҃твеннымъ Дх҃омъ, на́мъ бы́вше оде́жда спасе́нїа, и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїа вина̀, и҆ лю́тыхъ премѣне́нїе, вопїю́щымъ: всѧ̑ дѣла̀ бл҃гвите Гдⷭ҇нѧ Гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* You have stood against all the snares of the enemy's malice, O holy ones, by the divine Spirit, having become for us a garment of salvation, and the cause of forgiveness, and the transformation of cruel afflictions, as we cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сы́нове по прича́стїю Бж҃їи, дамїа́не и҆ космò бы́вше, вѣ́рою ѻ҆те́ческїй жре́бїй ны́нѣ ѡ҆брѣто́сте, нб҃ное наслажде́нїе, и҆ чꙋде́съ свѣ́тлое вои́стиннꙋ дѣ́йство. И҆ вопїе́те: всѧ̑ дѣла̀ бл҃гвите Гдⷭ҇нѧ Гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having become sons of God by participation, O Damian and Cosmas, by faith you have now obtained the paternal lot: heavenly delight and truly the bright operation of wonders. And you cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ка́плями ва́шими бг҃олѣ́пными, скве́рнꙋ ѡ҆мы́йте дꙋше́внꙋю на́шꙋ, и҆ болѣ́зненныѧ ст҃і́и прожени́те стра̑сти, и҆ де́мѡнскаѧ стремле́нїа ѿими́те: ꙗ҆́кѡ предста́телїе, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ цѣли́телїе на́ши млⷭ҇ти́вїи.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* With your divinely-befitting drops wash away our soul's defilement, and drive away painful passions, O holy ones, and remove the assaults of demons, as our protectors and as our merciful healers.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: ᲊмерщвлѧ́етсѧ сме́рть тобо́ю, жи́знь бо родила̀ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆поста́снꙋю, Хр[іс]та̀ Бг҃а пречⷭ҇таѧ, и҆ предста́тели жи́зни на́шеѧ показа́вшаго, безсре́бренники врачѝ, вопїю́щымъ: бл҃гослове́нъ пречⷭ҇таѧ пло́дъ твоегѡ̀ чре́ва.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. і҆рмо́съ: Е҆́ѵа ᲂу҆́бѡ недꙋ́гомъ преслꙋша́нїа, клѧ́твꙋ всели́ла є҆́сть. Ты́ же дв҃о Бцⷣе, прозѧбе́нїемъ чревоноше́нїа, мі́рови бл҃гослове́нїе процвѣла̀ є҆сѝ. Тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ всѝ велича́емъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѐ ны́нѣ что̀ добро̀, и҆лѝ что̀ кра́сно, ꙗ҆́коже пи́шетъ? но то́кмѡ є҆́же жи́ти ны́нѣ бра́тїи въ є҆диномꙋ́шленїи, въ мѣ́стѣ свѣтоза́рнѣ, въ се́лѣхъ нб҃ныхъ, въ сла́вѣ невѧ́нꙋющей, ꙗ҆́же достоѧ́нїю ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* "Behold now, what is so good or what is so pleasant," as it is written, save for brethren now to dwell in oneness of mind in the radiant place, in the heavenly mansions, in unfading glory, whom we worthily call blessed!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь сра́дꙋютсѧ на́мъ бл҃же́ннїи, въ па́мѧти ва́шей, а҆́гг҃ли, и҆ бж҃твеннїи а҆пл҃и, проро́цы и҆ прпⷣбнїи, и҆ всѝ пра́ведницы, съ ни́миже ра́достнѡ водворѧ́ющесѧ, за ве́сь мі́ръ молѧ́тсѧ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃твеннаѧ дво́ице и҆ свѣтоза́рнаѧ, безсре́бреннїи и҆ бг҃оно́снїи и҆ всечⷭ҇тні́и, ѡ҆ставле́нїе согрѣше́нїй, и҆ и҆справле́нїе житїѧ̀ и҆спроси́те, и҆ всѣ́хъ лю́тыхъ и҆збавле́нїе, восхваля́ющымъ ва́съ всегда̀.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бл҃года́ть и҆сцѣле́нїй ѿ Бг҃а прїе́мше, безсре́бреннѡ стра̑сти дꙋ́шъ и҆ тѣле́съ на́шихъ те́плѣ и҆сцѣлѧ́ете, прекра́снїи безсре́бренницы: тѣ́мже ва́ми Хрїсто́съ вѣ́рнымъ да́нное здра́вїе да́рꙋѧ, свѣти̑ла неле̑стнаѧ ва́съ пока́зꙋетъ вселе́ннѣй. Того̀ ᲂу҆моли́те спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having received the grace of healings from God, you freely and fervently heal the passions of our souls and bodies, O all-comely unmercenaries. Therefore Christ, bestowing given health through you unto the faithful, shows you forth to the universe as unfailing beacons. Entreat Him that our souls may be saved!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѿ вы́шнагѡ про́мысла бе́зднꙋ и҆сцѣле́нїй почер́пше, всѣ̑мъ и҆сточа́ете вѣ́рнымъ и҆сцѣле́нїа безсре́бренницы: преесте́ственнѣ бо недꙋ́гꙋющихъ стра̑сти, рꙋкодѣ́йствїи та́инственными, ѿ сокро́вищъ Дх҃а лѣ́чбы предлага́юще спаси́тєльныѧ, стра́ждꙋщихъ и҆сцѣлѧ́ете. Тѣ́мже хра́мъ че́стенъ бы́вше живонача́льныѧ Трⷪ҇цы, въ ва́съ бо ꙗ҆́вѣ ѡ҆би́тель сотворѝ: є҆́йже моли́теся спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having drawn an abyss of healings from the Providence on high, you pour forth healings unto all the faithful, O unmercenaries; for supernaturally, through mystical handiwork, offering saving remedies from the treasures of the Spirit for the sufferings of the sick, you heal those who suffer. Therefore, having become an honored temple of the Life-originating Trinity, for It manifestly made Its dwelling in you: pray to It that our souls may be saved!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Любо́вїю бж҃твенною, и҆ жела́нїемъ бꙋ́дꙋщихъ, дѣ́тельнѣ пожи́вше, спаси́тєльныѧ пꙋти̑ и҆спра́висте. Тѣ́мже чистотꙋ̀ дꙋше́внꙋю нескве́рнѡ соблю́дше, ве́щнымъ до конца̀ проти́вꙋ ста́сте: Дх҃омъ же бж҃твеннымъ ѡ҆зарѧ́ющеся, беззла́тнѡ и҆сцѣле́нїе недꙋ́гꙋющымъ подае́те, дво́ице сщ҃еннаѧ, свѣтоза́рное собра́нїе, просвѣще́нный бж҃е́ственный сопрѧ́же безсре́бренницы, въ ско́рбехъ и҆ болѣ́знехъ посѣща́юще на́съ, и҆ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ недꙋ́ги безме́здно и҆сцѣлѧ́юще.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having lived actively in divine love and desire for the things to come, you set aright saving pathways. Therefore, having kept spiritual purity undefiled, you stood against material things unto the end; and being enlightened by the divine Spirit, you freely bestow healing upon the infirm, O sacred pair, light-bearing assembly, enlightened divine yoke of unmercenaries, visiting us in tribulations and sicknesses, and gratuitously healing the infirmities of our souls.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вели́кимъ сподо́блшеся даро́мъ прехва́льнїи, въ смире́нномъ житїѝ на землѝ пожи́сте: и҆ проходѧ́ще всюдꙋ̀, тꙋ́не болѧ́щихъ стра̑сти и҆сцѣлѧ́юще, ꙗ҆ви́стеся а҆́гг҃лѡмъ собесѣ́дницы, космò съ дамїа́номъ мꙋ́дрымъ, бра́тїа прекра́сніи: и҆ на́ша стра̑сти, мл҃твами ва́шими, и҆сцѣли́те.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having been accounted worthy of great gifts, O all-praised ones, you lived in humble conduct upon the earth; and going about everywhere, freely healing the sufferings of the sick, you were revealed as companions of the angels, Cosmas with wise Damian, all-comely brethren: heal our passions also by your prayers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆сто́чникъ и҆сцѣле́нїй, є҆ди́наго то́кмѡ въ лѣ́тѣ и҆сцѣлева́ше, хра́мъ же безсре́бренникѡвъ всѐ мно́жество и҆сцѣлѧ́етъ недꙋ́гꙋющихъ: неѡскꙋ́дно бо є҆́сть и҆ неиждива́емое бога́тство ст҃ы́хъ. Тѣ́хъ мл҃твами Хр[іс]тѐ поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The pool of healing[^8] healed only one a year, but the temple of the unmercenaries heals the whole multitude of the sick; for unfailing and unspent is the riches of the saints. By their prayers, O Christ, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́дꙋетсѧ ли́къ ст҃ы́хъ во вѣ́ки, црⷭ҇тво бо нб҃ное наслѣ́доваша: землѧ̀ мѡ́щы и҆́хъ прїе́мши, бл҃гово́нїе расточѝ: рабѝ Хр[іс]тѡ́вы бы́вше, всели́шася въ жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю.
items.english_cohort_translation: The choir of the saints rejoices unto ages, for they have inherited the Heavenly Kingdom; the earth, having received their relics, poured forth fragrance: having been servants of Christ, they have taken up their dwelling in life eternal.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆сто́чникъ и҆сцѣле́нїй, и҆мꙋ́ще ст҃і́и безсре́бренницы: и҆сцѣле́нїе подае́те всѣ̑мъ тре́бꙋющымъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ вели́кимъ даро́мъ сподо́блшесѧ, ѿ приснотекꙋ́щагѡ и҆сто́чника сп҃са хрⷭ҇та̀. рече́ бо къ ва́мъ гдⷭ҇ь, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆диноревни́телемъ а҆пл҃ѡвъ: сѐ да́хъ ва́мъ вла́сть над̾ дꙋ́хи нечи́стыми, ꙗ҆́коже тѣ́хъ и҆згони́ти, и҆ и҆сцѣли́ти всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ, и҆ всѧ́кꙋю ꙗ҆́звꙋ. Тѣ́мже въ повелѣ́нїихъ є҆гѡ̀ до́брѣ пожи́вше, тꙋ́не прїѧ́сте, тꙋ́не подае́те, и҆сцѣлѧ́юще стра̑сти дꙋ́шъ и҆ тѣле́съ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having a fountain of healings, O holy unmercenaries, you bestow healing upon all who are in need, having been accounted worthy of great gifts from the ever-flowing fountain, the Savior Christ. For the Lord said unto you, as unto equal zealots of the apostles: "Behold, I have given you authority over unclean spirits, so as to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every infirmity."[^9] Therefore, having lived well in His commandments, freely you received, freely you give, healing the passions of our souls and bodies.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Распина́ема хрⷭ҇та̀ чл҃колю́бца ви́дѧщи пречⷭ҇таѧ, * и҆ ре́бра и҆скопава́ема копі́емъ, * пла́чꙋщи вопїѧ́ше: * что̀ сїѐ сн҃е мо́й? * что́ ти безбл҃года́тні́и лю́дїе возда́ша, * за ꙗ҆̀же сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ дѡ́браѧ и҆̀мъ? * и҆ тщи́шисѧ безча́дствовати мѧ̀ вселюбезнѣ́йшій: * ᲂу҆дивлѧ́юсѧ бл҃гоꙋтро́бне * твоемꙋ̀ во́льномꙋ распѧ́тїю.
items.english_cohort_translation: Seeing Christ, the Lover of mankind, being crucified, and His side pierced with a spear, the most pure one cried aloud, weeping: What is this, O my Son? What have the ungrateful people rendered unto Thee in return for the good things Thou didst do for them? And art Thou striving to leave me childless, O most beloved One? I marvel, O compassionate One, at Thy voluntary crucifixion!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кто̀ не ᲂу҆диви́тсѧ? кто̀ не просла́витъ? кто̀ не воспое́тъ вѣ́рнѡ, мꙋ́дрыхъ и҆ пресла́вныхъ безсре́бренникъ чꙋдеса̀? ꙗ҆́кѡ да и҆ по ст҃о́мъ и҆́хъ преставле́нїи, всѣ̑мъ подаю́тъ притека́ющымъ вѣ́рою, бога́тнѡ и҆сцѣле́нїа, и҆ честна́ѧ и҆ ст҃а́ѧ мѡ́щы тѣ́хъ и҆сточа́ютъ бл҃года́ть и҆сцѣле́ній: Ѽ дво́ице ст҃а́ѧ! Ѽ чт҃ны́ѧ главы̑! Ѽ премꙋ́дросте и҆ сла́во! ꙗ҆́же ѿ бг҃а да́нныѧ ва́ма бл҃года́ти. Тѣ́мже пѣ́снми зове́мъ бл҃годѣ́телю бг҃ꙋ, показа́вшемꙋ тѣ́хъ на врачева́нїе дꙋ́шъ и҆ тѣле́съ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Who will not marvel? Who will not glorify? Who will not faithfully sing of the wonders of the wise and most glorious unmercenaries? How even after their holy departure they richly bestow healings upon all who run unto them with faith, and their precious and holy relics pour forth the grace of healings! O holy pair! O honored heads! O wisdom and glory of the grace given unto you from God! Therefore with hymns we cry unto God the Benefactor, Who showed them forth for the healing of our souls and bodies.

items.english_cohort_translation: The undefiled Heifer, seeing the Young Bull willingly nailed upon the Tree, weeping piteously, cried aloud: Woe is me, most beloved Child! What has the ungrateful Jewish assembly rendered unto Thee, wishing to make me childless of Thee, O all-beloved One?

Therefore, unto those who piously make supplications, O most pure one, cease not to pray fervently for all who faithfully celebrate the deposition of thy precious robe.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃твенное торжество̀ наста̀ дне́сь бра́тїе: да и҆гра́етъ тва́рь, и҆ чл҃вѣ́чество да ликовствꙋетъ. Созыва́етъ бо на́съ бцⷣа, непоро́чное дѣ́вства сокро́вище, мы́сленный втора́гѡ а҆да́ма ра́й, составле́нїе соедине́нїѧ сꙋгꙋ́быхъ є҆сте́ствъ, торжество̀ спаси́телнагѡ примире́нїѧ, въ не́мже сло́во ѡ҆брꙋчѝ себѣ̀ пло́ть: ле́гкїй вои́стиннꙋ ѻ҆́блакъ, ꙗ҆́же съ пло́тїю и҆́же на херꙋві́мѣхъ носѧ́щаѧ. Тоѧ̀ мл҃твами хрⷭ҇тѐ сп҃сѝ дꙋ́шы на́ша.
items.english_cohort_translation: A divine solemnity has arrived today, brethren: let creation leap for joy, and let mankind dance! For the Mother of God summons us, the blameless treasure of virginity, the spiritual paradise of the Second Adam, the composition of the union of the two natures, the solemnity of saving reconciliation, in which the Word betrothed flesh unto Himself: truly a light cloud, bearing Him with the flesh Who sits upon the Cherubim. By her prayers, O Christ, save our souls!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Да́лъ є҆сѝ чл҃колю́бче твою̀ мт҃рь, * по́мощь рабѡ́мъ твои̑мъ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ: * є҆́юже неизрече́нное и҆ стра́шное содѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ смотре́нїе твоѐ: * и҆ первозда́нное на́ше и҆спра́вилъ є҆сѝ бж҃твенное досто́инство. * Тѣ́мже всечестно́е тоѧ̀ чтꙋ́ще торжество̀, * воспѣва́емъ держа́вꙋ твою̀, * і҆исꙋ́се всеси́льне, * сп҃се дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ. Два́жды.

Therefore, honoring her all-honorable solemnity, we hymn Thy dominion, O Jesus all-powerful, Savior of our souls! *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гра́дъ почита́ющїй тѧ̀, и҆ по до́лгꙋ сла́вѧщїй, * ѡ҆гражда́еши всепѣ́таѧ, * ри́зою твое́ю честно́ю * ѿ безбо́жныхъ чи́стаѧ и҆ноплеме́нникъ, * ѿ гла́да же и҆ трꙋ́са, * и҆ междоꙋсо́бныѧ бра́ни всегда̀, * дв҃о неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ. * И҆ сегѡ̀ ра́ди сла́витъ тѧ̀ пречⷭ҇таѧ бг҃оневѣ́сто, * чл҃вѣ́кѡвъ помо́щнице. Два́жды.
items.english_cohort_translation: The city that honors thee and glorifies thee as is due, O all-hymned one, thou dost compass about with thy precious robe, O pure one, from godless foreigners, and from famine, earthquake, and civil strife at all times, O Virgin unwedded. And for this cause the city glorifies thee, O most pure Bride of God, helper of mankind! *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ри́зꙋ честнꙋ́ю твою̀, * бг҃обл҃года́тнаѧ влⷣчце, * дарова́ла є҆сѝ гра́дꙋ твоемꙋ̀, * бога́тство неѿе́млемо: * покро́въ же и҆ сла́вꙋ, * и҆ неѡбори́мꙋ стѣ́нꙋ, * и҆ и҆сцѣле́нїй сокро́вище, * чꙋде́съ и҆сто́чникъ приснотекꙋ́щїй, * приста́нище же спаси́телное ѡ҆бꙋрева́ємымъ всегда̀. * Сегѡ̀ ра́ди пое́мъ тѧ̀, препѣ́таѧ чⷭ҇таѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thy precious robe, O Lady full of God's grace, thou hast given unto thy city as an inalienable riches, as a protection and glory, and an invincible wall, and a treasury of healings, an ever-flowing fountain of wonders, and a saving harbor for those who are ever tempest-tossed. Therefore we sing of thee, O all-hymned and pure one!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Почерпи́те человѣ́цы, * здра́вїе дꙋ́шъ и҆ тѣ́ла: * ра́ка бо всѣ̑мъ предлежи́тъ, * въ не́йже положи́ся честна́ѧ ри́за приснодв҃ы, * и҆сточа́ющаѧ на́мъ чꙋде́съ стрꙋи̑, * и҆ ѡ҆мыва́ющаѧ серде́цъ ѡ҆мраче́нїа, * и҆ страсте́й ѡ҆скверне́нїа, * и҆ дꙋ́шы ѡ҆сщ҃а́ющаѧ вѣ́рныхъ, * бж҃твенною бл҃года́тїю.
items.english_cohort_translation: Draw forth, O men, health of souls and body! For the shrine lies before all, wherein was placed the precious robe of the Ever-Virgin, pouring forth streams of wonders unto us, and washing away the dark defilements of hearts and the pollutions of passions, and sanctifying the souls of the faithful with divine grace.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Смы́слъ ѡ҆чи́стивше и҆ ᲂу҆́мъ, со а҆́гг҃лы и҆ мы̀ торжествꙋ́емъ, свѣ́тлѡ начина́юще дв҃дскꙋю пѣ́снь, ѻ҆трокови́цѣ невѣ́стѣ всѣ́хъ цр҃ѧ̀ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а на́шегѡ:
items.english_cohort_translation: Having cleansed our understanding and mind, let us also celebrate with the angels, brightly beginning the Davidic song unto the Maiden-Bride of the King of all, Christ our God: saying: "Arise, O Lord, into Thy rest, Thou and the ark of Thy sanctuary!"[^11] For having adorned her as a beauteous palace, He assigned her unto Thy city as a good thing, to govern and shelter it from the adversary pagans by Thy sovereign power, through her prayers.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кто̀ тебѐ по достоѧ́нїю восхва́литъ, и҆ ᲂу҆блажи́тъ ѻ҆трокови́це бг҃оневѣ́сто, ѡ҆ и҆́же тебє̀ ра́ди бы́вшемъ и҆збавле́нїи мі́рови? бл҃годарѧ́ще ᲂу҆́бо вопїе́мъ тѝ влⷣчце: ра́дꙋйсѧ, ꙗ҆́же а҆да́ма ѡ҆божи́вшаѧ, и҆ разсѣ́ѧвшаѧсѧ въ є҆ди́но собра́вшаѧ. Ра́дꙋйсѧ просвѣти́вшаѧ ро́дъ на́шъ, воскрⷭ҇нїемъ пресвѣ́тлымъ сн҃а твоегѡ̀ и҆ бг҃а на́шегѡ. Тебѐ бо хрⷭ҇тїа́нскїй ро́дъ непреста́ннѡ ᲂу҆блажа́етъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Who will worthily praise and bless thee, O Maiden Bride of God, for the deliverance that came unto the world through thee? Giving thanks, therefore, we cry aloud unto thee, O Lady: Rejoice, thou who hast deified Adam and gathered together into one those who were scattered! Rejoice, thou who hast enlightened our race by the most bright Resurrection of thy Son and our God! For the Christian race incessantly calls thee blessed.

Ра́дꙋйсѧ просвѣти́вшаѧ ро́дъ на́шъ, воскрⷭ҇нїемъ пресвѣ́тлымъ сн҃а твоегѡ̀ и҆ бг҃а на́шегѡ. Тебѐ бо хрⷭ҇тїа́нскїй ро́дъ непреста́ннѡ ᲂу҆блажа́етъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Премѣне́нїе, и҆ жи́знь чл҃вѣ́чагѡ є҆стества̀ второ́ю, познава́емъ пречⷭ҇таѧ мр҃і́е тобо́ю, въ ᲂу҆тро́бѣ твое́й вмѣсти́вшаѧ творца̀ тва́ри, воскреси́вшаго на́съ ѿ а҆́да и҆ сме́рти, и҆ живо́тъ на́мъ вѣ́чный дарова́вшаго. Тѣ́мже вопїе́мъ тебѣ̀ приснодв҃о: ра́дꙋйсѧ, совокꙋ́пльшаѧ до̑льнѧѧ нб҃нымъ. Ра́дꙋйсѧ ᲂу҆пова́нїе всѣ̑мъ концє́мъ землѝ, и҆ предста́тельнице, и҆ застꙋпле́нїе. Ра́дꙋйсѧ прест҃ы́мъ ржⷭ҇тво́мъ твои́мъ просвѣти́вшаѧ всѧ́чєскаѧ: и҆ подаю́щаѧ мі́рови ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_cohort_translation: A transformation and a second life of human nature we have come to know through thee, O most pure Mary, who didst contain in thy womb the Creator of creation, Who raised us from Hades and death and granted us eternal life. Therefore we cry unto thee, O Ever-Virgin: Rejoice, thou who hast united the earthly with the heavenly! Rejoice, hope, protection, and defense unto all the ends of the earth! Rejoice, thou who by thy most holy childbirth hast enlightened all things, and who dost grant great mercy unto the world!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́же въ вы́шнихъ съ ѻ҆ц҃е́мъ и҆ дх҃омъ сн҃ъ славосло́вимый ѿ серафі́мъ, первозда́ннаго ѡ҆бнови́ти хотѧ̀, всего̀ са́мъ себѐ и҆стощѝ неизрече́ннѡ во ᲂу҆тро́бѣ твое́й, бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ. И҆ возсїѧ́въ и҆з̾ тебє̀, мі́ръ ве́сь просвѣти́лъ є҆́сть бж҃е[ствомъ]
items.english_cohort_translation: The Son Who is glorified on high with the Father and the Spirit by the Seraphim, desiring to renew the first-formed, emptied Himself wholly and ineffably in thy womb, O all-hymned Mother of God. And having shone forth from thee, He enlightened the whole world with Divinity delivering them from the madness of idols. And having renewed mankind in Himself, Christ God and the Savior of our souls brought it up unto the heavens.

items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst conceive without seed, and didst ineffably give birth unto Him Who casts down the mighty from thrones and exalts the humble, Who raises up the horn of His anointed ones that glorify Christ's Cross, burial, and Resurrection. Therefore, O Mother of God, as the mediatress of so many blessings, we call thee blessed with unceasing hymns, and we celebrate the deposition of thy precious robe.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зача́ла є҆сѝ безсѣ́меннѡ, и҆ родила́ є҆сѝ неизрече́ннѡ низлага́ющаго си̑льныѧ съ престѡ́лъ, и҆ возносѧ́ща смире́нныѧ: ро́гъ же пома́занныхъ свои́хъ возставлѧ́юща, славосло́вѧщихъ крⷭ҇тъ хв҃ъ, погребе́нїе, и҆ воскрⷭ҇нїе. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ бцⷣе толи́кихъ бл҃гъ вино́внꙋю хода́таицꙋ, немо́лчными пѣ́снми ᲂу҆блажа́емъ: и҆ чт҃ны́ѧ твоеѧ̀ ри́зы пра́зднꙋемъ положе́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Come, all ye nations, with voices of rejoicing let us praise the all-holy Virgin and Mother of God, the furnace of human substance, the worker of ineffable mysteries; for in her a new and most glorious mystery has come to pass: the Unoriginate has arrived, the Word has taken on substance, God becomes man that He may make man god! Her therefore we fervently entreat, that our souls may be saved.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїиди́те всѝ ꙗ҆зы́цы, въ гла́сѣхъ ра́дованїѧ, всест҃ꙋ́ю дв҃ꙋ и҆ бцⷣꙋ восхва́лимъ, чл҃чєскагѡ сꙋщества̀ пе́щь, неизрече́нныхъ та́инъ дѣ́лательницꙋ: въ не́й бо но́ва и҆ пресла́вна та́йна собы́тисѧ. Безнача́льный прїи́де, сло́во ѡ҆дебелѣ̀: бг҃ъ человѣ́къ быва́етъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ да человѣ́ка бг҃а содѣ́лаетъ. Сїю̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ прилѣ́жнѡ мо́лимъ, спасти́ся дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O all-hymned and all-glorious Queen and Mother of God, Mother of the Maker of all creation, Christian hope and protectress, consolation of the sorrowful, speedy expectation of the despairing and hopeless, we pray thee: be merciful unto us sinners; forsake not thy servants, and reject not the supplications of the unworthy! We pray thee as we gaze upon thine honored icon: with those who sail and those who travel by land, let thy mercy abide. O Lady, defend with thy precious robe and preserve thy cities and people in every place from the assault of barbarians; and pray unto Christ our God Who was born of thee, that He may save our souls from sins!

slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source: Прїиди́те всѝ ꙗ҆зы́цы, въ гла́сѣхъ ра́дованїѧ, всест҃ꙋ́ю дв҃ꙋ и҆ бцⷣꙋ восхва́лимъ, чл҃чєскагѡ сꙋщества̀ пе́щь, неизрече́нныхъ та́инъ дѣ́лательницꙋ: въ не́й бо но́ва и҆ пресла́вна та́йна собы́тисѧ. items.preceding_stichos: Verse: Arise, O Lord, into Thy rest, Thou and the ark of Thy sanctuary. [Ps. 131:8 LXX]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ри́зꙋ чт҃нꙋ́ю твою̀, * твоѐ чт҃но́е и҆ ст҃о́е тѣ́ло * чи́стаѧ покры́вшꙋю, * ѡ҆де́ждꙋ сла́вы дарова́ла є҆сѝ всѣ̑мъ, * и҆ и҆сто́чникъ и҆сточа́ющь, * бл҃года́ти присноживѡ́тныѧ во́ды, * є҆ѧ́же пра́зднꙋемъ положе́нїе, * почита́юще тѧ̀ бцⷣе, * всѣ́хъ честнѣ́йшꙋю.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, и҃. Бцⷣе приснодв҃о чл҃вѣ́кѡвъ покро́ве, ри́зꙋ и҆ по́ѧсъ пречⷭ҇тагѡ твоегѡ̀ тѣлесѐ, держа́вное гра́дꙋ твоемꙋ̀ ѡ҆бложе́нїе дарова́ла є҆сѝ, безсѣ́меннымъ ржⷭ҇тво́мъ твои́мъ, нетлѣ́нна пребыва́ющи: ѡ҆ тебѣ́ бо и҆ є҆стество̀ ѡ҆бновлѧ́етсѧ и҆ вре́мѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: As with a most bright crown, O all-pure Mother of God, the Church of God has clothed herself with thy precious robe; and today she shines and rejoices, and mystically celebrates, O Lady, crying unto thee: Rejoice, honored diadem and crown of divine glory! Rejoice, only perfection of glory and eternal gladness! Rejoice, haven, deliverance, and our salvation for those who run unto thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Красото́ю дѣ́вства твоегѡ̀, прекра́сное сло́во ро́ждши: и҆ сегѡ̀ ри́зою твое́ю чи́стаѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ младе́нца пелена́ла є҆сѝ. Сїю̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ дарова́ла є҆сѝ рабѡ́мъ твои̑мъ влⷣчце: покро́въ, по́мощь, и҆ и҆сто́чникъ сщ҃е́нїа. Е҆ѧ́же честно́е положе́нїе пречⷭ҇таѧ дв҃о, всѝ вѣ́рнѡ пра́зднꙋемъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: By the beauty of thy virginity having given birth unto the all-comely Word, and Him, O pure one, as an Infant thou didst swaddle with thy robe. This, therefore, thou hast granted unto thy servants, O Lady: a protection, help, and fountain of sanctification; whose precious deposition, O most pure Virgin, we all faithfully celebrate.

items.section: After the second Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ржⷭ҇тво̀ нетлѣ́нно и҆ дѣ́вство, є҆ди́на и҆мѣ́ла є҆сѝ бл҃гослове́ннаѧ: ѡ҆дѣѧ́нїе же чл҃кѡ́мъ спаси́телно, твою̀ ст҃ꙋ́ю ри́зꙋ дарова́ла є҆сѝ, да́же до ны́нѣ нетлѣ́ннѡ пребыва́ющꙋю бг҃оневѣ́сто. Е҆ѧ́же ра́ди ѿ бг҃а прїе́млемъ рабѝ твоѝ чⷭ҇таѧ, ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_cohort_translation: Incorrupt childbirth and virginity thou alone didst possess, O blessed one; and as a saving garment unto men, thou hast granted thy holy robe, which even unto now remains incorrupt, O Bride of God; for whose sake we thy servants, O pure one, receive great mercy from God.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пра́зднꙋетъ дне́сь вселе́ннаѧ, честно́е положе́нїе твоѧ̀ ри́зы, Ѽ чⷭ҇таѧ! и҆ съ любо́вїю взыва́етъ тѝ: ра́дꙋйсѧ дв҃о, вѣ́рнымъ помо́щнице.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today the universe celebrates the precious deposition of thy robe, O pure one, and with love cries unto thee: Rejoice, O Virgin, helper of the faithful!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Чт҃ны́ѧ ри́зы твоеѧ̀ положе́нїе, пра́зднꙋютъ дне́сь лю́дїе твоѝ всепѣ́таѧ: и҆ ᲂу҆се́рднѡ взыва́ютъ тѝ: ра́дꙋйсѧ дв҃о хрⷭ҇тїа́нѡмъ похвало̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today thy people celebrate the deposition of thy precious robe, O all-hymned one, and fervently cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Virgin, boast of Christians!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ди̑вна правосла́вныхъ торжества̀, дне́сь соте́кшеся вѣ́рнїи ѱало́мски воспое́мъ, глаго́люще: воскреснѝ гдⷭ҇и въ поко́й тво́й, ты̀, и҆ кївѡ́тъ ст҃ы́ни твоеѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ побѣ́дꙋ дарова́лъ на́мъ сло́ве, ри́зꙋ пречⷭ҇тыѧ тѝ мт҃ре. Е҆ѧ́же мл҃твами всеси́льне, ᲂу҆мирѝ мі́ръ, и҆ сп҃сѝ дꙋ́шы на́ша.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron, Tone 6:* Marvelous are the celebrations of the Orthodox! Assembled today, let us faithfully sing with the psalms, saying: "Arise, O Lord, into Thy rest, Thou and the ark of Thy sanctuary,"[^15] for Thou, O Word, hast granted us the robe of Thy most pure Mother as victory. Through her prayers, O All-Powerful One, make the world peaceful, and save our souls!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Трїста́ты крѣ̑пкїѧ, рожде́йсѧ ѿ дв҃ы, безстра́стїѧ во глубинѣ̀, дꙋ́ши трича́стное потопѝ молю́ся, да тебѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ въ тѷмпа́нѣ, во ᲂу҆мерщвле́нїи тѣлесѐ побѣ́дное воспою̀ пѣ́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Having been born of the Virgin, drown, I pray, the threefold part of my soul in the depth of dispassion, O Mighty Conqueror of captains, that unto Thee as on a timbrel, in the mortification of the body, I may sing a song of victory.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ри́зꙋ твою̀ чт҃нꙋ́ю бцⷣе дв҃о, чтꙋ́щымъ тѧ̀ лю́демъ дарова́ла є҆сѝ при́снѡ, сщ҃е́нное ѡ҆гражде́нїе: всѧ́кое сопроти́вныхъ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїе, всегда̀ побѣжда́ющи си́лою дх҃о́вною.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thy precious robe, O Mother of God and Virgin, thou hast given ever unto the people who honor thee as a sacred defense, always overcoming every assault of adversaries by spiritual power.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пло́тїю на́съ ра́ди ѿ чт҃ы́хъ твои́хъ крове́й, ꙗ҆́вльшагѡся на землѝ, ри́зꙋ сщ҃е́ннꙋю ѡ҆саза́нїемъ, ѡ҆ст҃и́ла є҆сѝ, и҆ тѣлесѐ твоегѡ̀ прикосновенїемъ: є҆́ѧже ра́ди всѧ̑ рабы̑ твоѧ̑ ѡ҆сщ҃а́еши дв҃о пою́щыѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having appeared upon earth in the flesh for our sake from thy pure blood, thou didst sanctify the sacred robe by wearing it and by the touch of thy body; for whose sake thou dost sanctify all thy servants who sing of thee, O Virgin.

items.section: Sessional Hymn, Tone 4.* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Вознесы́йсѧ: Чꙋде́съ рѣ́ки бцⷣе, ѿ всечⷭ҇тныѧ твоеѧ̀ ра́ки происходѧ́щїа, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆з̾ є҆де́ма напаѧ́ютъ лицѐ землѝ бл҃года́ти пролива́ющїа, вѣ́рнѡ тѧ̀ чтꙋ́щымъ: тѣ́мже тѧ̀ воспѣва́емъ, и҆ вѣ́рнѡ восхваля́емъ, и҆ бл҃годарнѡ всегда̀ взыва́емъ взыва́емъ: ра́дꙋйсѧ є҆ди́на наде́жде пою́щихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Rivers of wonders, O Mother of God, proceeding from thine all-honorable shrine, as from Eden water the face of the earth, pouring forth graces unto those who faithfully honor thee; therefore we hymn thee, faithfully praise thee, and ever cry aloud with thanksgiving saying: Rejoice, only hope of those who sing of thee!

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ пречт҃нꙋю тве́рдь бцⷣе, творе́цъ и҆ зижди́тель тѧ̀ водрꙋзи́вый: ꙗ҆́коже ѕвѣзда́ми ᲂу҆краси́ тѧ бж҃твенными сїѧ́нїи, и҆́миже ᲂу҆краша́еши концы̀.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѿ землѝ на́съ возгла́читъ къ нб҃сѝ бг҃ороди́тельнице, бж҃твеннаѧ твоѧ̀ ри́за чт҃аѧ, любо́вїю сїѧ̀ распалены̀ те́плѣ: тѣ́мже тѧ̀ сла́вимъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ лꙋ́чшагѡ винꙋ̀.

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѐ бл҃года́ть неисчерпа́емаѧ, прїиди́те всѝ сокрꙋше́ннымъ срⷣцемъ, почерпи́те бж҃твенныѧ то́ки, и҆сточа́ющїѧ незави́стнѡ, Ѽ празднолю́бцы, ѿ чт҃ны́ѧ ра́ки твоеѧ̀ всепѣ́таѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Behold inexhaustible grace! Come, all ye with contrite heart, draw forth the divine streams pouring forth unstintingly, O lovers of the feast, from thine honored shrine, O all-hymned one!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Благода́ть бж҃їа, незави́стнѡ точа́щаѧ, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречⷭ҇таѧ бцⷣе, ѿ честны́ѧ ра́ки твоеѧ̀, любо́вїю покланѧ́ющымсѧ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Твое́ю си́лою вѣ́рнїи цр҃і́е ѡ҆поѧсꙋ́ютсѧ: тѧ̀ сою́зъ бцⷣе, тво́й и҆́мать гра́дъ: ри́зою твое́ю почита́етсѧ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Їрмо́съ: Ѡ҆́бразъ проѡбразꙋ́ѧ погребе́нїе тридне́вное, проро́къ їѡ́на, въ ки́тѣ молѧ́сѧ: ѿ тлѝ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀, і҆и҃се цр҃ю̀ си́лъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Показа́ла є҆сѝ всѣ́ми цр҃твꙋющемꙋ гра́дꙋ, ро́ждшаѧ цр҃ѧ̀ всѣ́хъ и҆ гдⷭ҇а, ꙗ҆́кѡ нерꙋши́мꙋю стѣ́нꙋ, чⷭ҇тнꙋ́ю и҆ ст҃ꙋ́ю ри́зꙋ твою̀.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4.* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́дꙋющесѧ дв҃ы благода́ть просла́вимъ, и҆ сеѧ̀ прест҃ꙋ́ю ри́зꙋ почти́мъ: и҆з̾ неѧ́же всѧ́ко здра́вїе немощны́мъ, непреста́ннѡ происхо́дитъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Rejoicing, let us glorify the grace of the Virgin, and let us honor her all-holy robe, from which all health unceasingly proceeds unto the infirm.

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Во́дъ тѧ̀ животочꙋ́щїй и҆сто́чникъ вѣ́мы бцⷣе, и҆ почита́емъ бж҃твеннꙋю ри́зꙋ твою̀: ѿ неѧ́же и҆сцѣле́нїе всегда̀, вѣ́рнїи почерпа́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* We know thee, O Mother of God, as a fountain welling forth living waters, and we honor thy divine robe, from which we, the faithful, ever draw forth healing.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крѣ́пость тѧ̀ вѣ́рнїи стѧжа́вше, и҆ похвалꙋ̀, ѡ҆дѣва́ютсѧ сла́вою, чⷭ҇тно́ю твое́ю ри́зою бг҃ороди́тельнице. ꙗ҆́коже пресвѣ́тлое ᲂу҆краше́нїе и҆ чⷭ҇тно́е, тѧ̀ стѧжа́вше.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having acquired thee as strength and praise, the faithful are clothed with glory through thine honored robe, O Birthgiver of God, having acquired thee as a most radiant and honored adornment.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ви́дѣти твою̀ бцⷣе сла́вꙋ неизрече́ннꙋю дре́вле, болѣ́зновахꙋ бж҃твеннїи прⷪ҇ро́цы всѝ: но въ послѣ̑днѧѧ днѝ на́мъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ, и҆́же лѣ́тъ превы́шшїй.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* All the divine prophets of old longed in travail to see thine ineffable glory, O Mother of God; but in the last days He Who is above all years appeared unto us.

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Вознесы́йсѧ: Ѡ҆дѣѧ́нїе всѣ̑мъ вѣ̑рнымъ нетлѣ́нїѧ, бг҃облагода́тнаѧ чⷭ҇таѧ дарова́ла є҆сѝ, сщ҃е́ннꙋю ри́зꙋ твою̀, є҆́юже сщ҃е́нное тѣ́ло твоѐ покрыва́ла є҆сѝ, покро́ве всѣ́хъ чл҃кѡвъ. Е҆ѧ́же положе́нїе пра́зднꙋемъ любо́вїю, и҆ вопїе́мъ со стра́хоти чⷭ҇таѧ: ра́дꙋйсѧ дв҃о хрⷭ҇тїа́нѡвъ похвало̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):* As a garment of incorruption for all the faithful, O pure one full of God's grace, thou hast bestowed thy sacred robe, with which thou didst cover thy sacred body, O protection of all men. Its deposition we celebrate with love, and with fear we cry unto thee, O pure one: Rejoice, O Virgin, the boast of Christians!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4.* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́косъ: Чи́стое ѡ҆дѣѧ́нїе, и҆ ски́нїю бж҃їѧ сло́ва, ѡ҆дꙋшевленныи ѡ҆́блакъ, и҆ ста́мнꙋ ма́нны, бцⷣꙋ мр҃і́ю, всѝ спа́сшїисѧ рождество́мъ є҆ѧ̀, вѣ́рою ᲂу҆блажи́мъ: и҆ чⷭ҇тнѣ́й ри́зѣ прикосне́мсѧ, є҆́юже влⷣкꙋ ѡ҆бви́вши, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆троча̀ носи́ла є҆́сть, въ пло́ть ѡ҆болкша́госѧ: є҆гѡ́же ра́ди человѣ́ческое є҆стество̀ взѧ́тсѧ ко превысоча́йшей жи́зни, и҆ црⷭ҇твїю. тѣ́мже съ ра́достїю вопїе́мъ велегла́снѡ: ра́дꙋйсѧ дв҃о, хрⷭ҇тїа́нѡвъ похвало̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* The pure garment and tabernacle of the Word of God, the animate cloud and jar of manna, Mary the Mother of God, let all of us who have been saved by her childbearing bless in faith; and let us touch the honored robe, with which having wrapped the Master, as an Infant she bore Him Who was clothed in flesh, for Whose sake human nature was lifted up unto the most high life and the Kingdom. Therefore with joy we cry aloud with a loud voice: Rejoice, O Virgin, the boast of Christians!

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃ороди́тельнице чⷭ҇таѧ, чтꙋ́щїй тѧ̀ гра́дъ, гла́да, тру́са же и҆ ѡ҆ѕлобле́нїѧ всѧ́кагѡ спаса́й, и҆ ꙗ҆зы́ческагѡ нахожде́нїѧ, и҆ сопроти́внагѡ вре́да.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* O pure Birthgiver of God, save the city that honors thee from famine, earthquake, and every affliction, and from the invasion of heathens, and from adverse harm.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. Їрмо́съ: Въ пещѝ а҆враа́мстїи ѻ҆́троцы, персі́дстѣй, любо́вїю бл҃гоче́стїѧ па́че, не́жели пла́менемъ ѡ҆палѧ́еми взыва́хꙋ: бл҃гвⷭ҇нъ є҆сѝ въ хра́мѣ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another [canon]. Ode 7. Heirmos:* In the Persian furnace, the Abrahamic children, inflamed by love of piety rather than by the flame, cried aloud: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4.* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ты ꙗ҆́коже сл҃нце пра́вды, є҆ди́нъ сы́й бл҃же, бж҃е́ственнѡ ᲂу҆кра́силъ є҆сѝ хра́мъ чⷭ҇тыѧ, разли́чными твои́ми дарова́нїи, въ не́мъ возсїѧ́вшыѧ лꙋчы̀ и҆спꙋща́етъ ѿ сеѧ̀ ри́зы.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* As the Sun of righteousness, Thou Who alone art good, hast divinely adorned the temple of the pure one with Thy diverse gifts, wherein having shone forth, she emits rays from this robe.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4.* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆злиѧ́ютъ чꙋдеса̀ пречⷭ҇таѧ бж҃твенныѧ ча́шы твоѧ̑, бл҃гть вои́стиннꙋю вѣ́рнымъ: и҆ незави́стнѡ чтꙋ́щымъ тѧ̀, ѿ твоеѧ̀ ра́ки пролива́ютсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆з̾ дрꙋга́гѡ є҆де́ма мы́сленныѧ рѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thy divine cups pour forth wonders, O most pure one, true grace unto the faithful; and unstintingly unto those who honor thee, noetic rivers pour forth from thy shrine as from another Eden.

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Скве́рны всѧ́кїѧ дꙋше́вныѧ, ѡ҆чисти́телна є҆́сть твоѧ̀ всенепоро́чнаѧ дв҃о, ра́ка и҆ покрыва́ющаѧ, чⷭ҇тно́е твоѐ тѣ́ло, покры́вшею ри́зою.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* A purifier of every soul's defilement is thy shrine, O all-blameless Virgin, which covers the robe that once covered thine honored body.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4.* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ны́нѣ пристꙋпи́те съ весе́лїемъ всѝ и҆́же на землѝ, прїидѝте ра́ка призыва́етъ та́йнѣ, ѡ҆бѧ́ти гл҃щи пресла́внꙋю, во мнѣ̀ сокро́виществованнꙋю ри́зꙋ є҆ѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Now draw near with gladness, all ye who are on earth; come, the shrine mystically summons you, saying: Embrace her most glorious robe, which is treasured within me!

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, и҆. Їрмо́съ: И҆зба́вителю всѣ́хъ всеси́лне, посредѣ̀ пла́мене бл҃гоче́ствовавшыѧ, снизше́дъ ѡ҆роси́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ навчи́лъ є҆сѝ пѣ́ти: всѧ̑ дѣла̀ бл҃гослови́те, по́йте гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* O Almighty Redeemer of all, having descended into the midst of the flame, Thou didst bedew those who practiced piety, and didst teach them to sing: All ye works, bless and praise the Lord!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Благода́рными гла́сы воспѣва́емъ тѧ̀, всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ на́мъ вино́внꙋю на́мъ хода́таицꙋ: и҆ чⷭ҇тнꙋ́ю ри́зꙋ твою̀ ѡ҆блобыза́юще ѻ҆трокови́це, взыва́емъ: бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* With thankful voices we sing of thee, the cause of all good things unto us, our mediating advocate; and kissing thine honored robe, O Maiden, we cry aloud: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ника́коже безча́стны ѡ҆ста́вила є҆сѝ, сщ҃е́ннагѡ твое́гѡ дв҃о прикосновенїѧ, недосто́йныѧ рабы̀ твоѧ̑: вмѣ́стѡ бо тѣ́ла твоегѡ̀ живоно́снагѡ, ри́зꙋ твою̀ всѣ̑мъ дарова́ла є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* In no wise hast thou left thine unworthy servants without a share in thy sacred touch, O Virgin; for in place of thy life-bearing body, thou hast granted thy robe unto all.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́сньми бж҃твенными почти́мъ, бж҃їе селе́нїе простра́нное, въ мт҃рехъ пречⷭ҇тꙋю, нб҃нꙋю две́рь: є҆́юже заключи́сѧ къ сме́рти две́рь ведꙋ́щаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* With divine hymns let us honor the spacious dwelling of God, the most pure among mothers, the heavenly gate, through which the door leading unto death was shut.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4.* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆́ггли пречⷭ҇таѧ, ны́нѣ сликовствꙋ́ютъ въ чⷭ҇тнѣ́мъ хра́мѣ твое́мъ чⷭ҇таѧ: и҆ ѡ҆крꙋжа́ютъ влⷣчце чⷭ҇тнꙋ́ю и҆ ст҃ꙋ́ю твою̀ ри́зꙋ, любо́вїю и҆ ра́достїю: мы́ же весе́лїемъ мно́гимъ покланѧ́емсѧ, воспѣва́юще тѧ̀ сла́вꙋ ро́да на́шегѡ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The angels now celebrate in choir in thine honored temple, O pure one, and they surround thine honored and holy robe with love and joy, O Lady; and we, with great gladness, fall down in worship, singing of thee as the glory of our race.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4.* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Жезлъ, и҆́же цвѣ́тъ жи́зни прозѧ́бшїй, ты̀ є҆сѝ всѣ́хъ ра́дость многоче́стнаѧ пречⷭ҇таѧ. мѵрополо́жница дх҃а, сокро́вище благи́хъ, а҆рѡма́тъ и҆сто́чникъ, и҆з̾ негѡ́же мѵ́ра и҆сцѣле́нїй, и҆сточа́етъ бж҃е́ственнаѧ ра́ка.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou art the rod that budded the Flower of life, the much-honored joy of all, O most pure one; vessel of the Spirit's myrrh, treasury of good things, fountain of sweet fragrances, from which the divine shrine wells forth the myrrh of healings.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4.* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Воспѣва́ютъ пречⷭ҇таѧ, вели́чїѧ твоѧ̑ чⷭ҇таѧ, мы́слєннаѧ вѡ́инства: проповѣ́дꙋютъ всѝ патрїа́рси, и҆ прⷪ҇ро́цы ꙗ҆́снѡ, и҆ а҆пл҃и ст҃і́и, и҆ мꙋ́чнкѡвъ ли́къ, и҆ прпⷣбныхъ всѐ исполне́нїе. съ ни́миже покланѧ́емъ ти сѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The noetic hosts sing of thy greatness, O most pure one; all the patriarchs and prophets clearly proclaim it, and the holy apostles, and the choir of martyrs, and the whole fullness of the venerable ones; with whom we worship thee.

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Їрмо́съ: Е҆́ѵа ᲂу҆́бѡ недꙋ́гомъ преслꙋша́нїѧ, кла́твꙋ всели́ла є҆́сть. ты́ же дв҃о бцⷣе, прозѧбе́нїемъ чревоноше́нїѧ, мі́рови бл҃гослове́нїе процвѣла̀ є҆сѝ. тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ всѝ велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Eve, through the disease of disobedience, brought in the curse; but thou, O Virgin Mother of God, through the budding fruit of thy womb, didst blossom forth blessing unto the world. Therefore we all magnify thee.

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь тѧ̀ пѣ́сней соломѡ́новъ почита́емъ, ра́достными пѣ́сньми: и҆ чⷭ҇тнꙋ́ю твою̀ ри́зꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ дрꙋгі́й кївѡ́тъ сщ҃е́нїѧ ѡ҆крꙋжи́вше, и҆сцѣле́нїа прїе́млемъ спаси́телнаѧ, при́снодв҃о.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* As the Song of Songs of Solomon we honor thee with joyful hymns; and having surrounded thine honored robe as another ark of sanctification, we receive saving healings, O Ever-Virgin.

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆ви́сѧ ны́нѣ бж҃твеннаѧ твоѧ̀ ра́ка, содержа́щаѧ ри́зꙋ твою̀ чⷭ҇тно́ю, ꙗ҆́коже и҆сто́чникъ свѣ́та дв҃о, лꙋчы̑ и҆сцѣле́нїй и҆спꙋща́ющи, и҆ тмꙋ̀ недꙋ́гѡвъ ѿгонѧ́щи, ю҆́же въ любо́вїю цѣлꙋ́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thy divine shrine containing thine honored robe has now appeared, O Virgin, as a fountain of light, emitting rays of healings and driving away the darkness of diseases, which shrine we kiss with love.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4.* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: дне́сь сра́дꙋютсѧ на́мъ, всенепоро́чнаѧ, покланѧ́нїемъ ри́зы твоеѧ̀, всѧ̑ нб҃ныѧ си́лы: а҆пл҃и, прⷪ҇ро́цы, и҆ мꙋ́ченницы: прпⷣбні́и, и҆ пра́веднїи всѝ, бл҃чце є҆ди́на приснодв҃о.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today all the heavenly hosts rejoice together with us, O all-blameless Lady, only Ever-Virgin, at the veneration of thy robe: the apostles, prophets, and martyrs, the venerable ones, and all the righteous.

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆свѧти́сѧ всѧ̀ землѧ̀, всест҃а́гѡ влⷣчня поко́ища, положе́нїемъ ри́зы твоеѧ̀. и҆ дв҃дъ ра́дꙋетсѧ дре́вле положе́нїемъ кївѡ́та, проѡбразꙋ́ющагѡ тѧ̀ приснодв҃о.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* All the earth is sanctified by the deposition of thy robe, the resting place of the all-holy Sovereign; and David of old rejoices at the placement of the ark, which prefigured thee, O Ever-Virgin.

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣ́тло ѡ҆дѣѧ́нїе, твою̀ ри́зꙋ дарова́ла є҆сѝ, и҆ ѡ҆гражде́нїе, тѧ̀ чтꙋ́щемꙋ ца́рствꙋющемꙋ гра́дꙋ, всѣ́хъ градѡ́въ, ꙗ҆́кѡ цр҃ица всѣ́хъ тва́рей сꙋ́щи, бг҃ороди́тельнице мт҃и дв҃о.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* As a radiant garment and a defense hast thou granted thy robe unto the reigning city of all cities which honors thee, as thou art the Queen of all creatures, O Birthgiver of God, Virgin Mother.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. Їрмо́съ: Ка́мень нерꙋкосѣ́чный ѿ несѣко́мыѧ горы̀ тебѐ дв҃о, краеꙋго́лный ѿсѣче́сѧ, хрⷭ҇то́съ совокꙋпи́вый, разстоѧ́щаѧсѧ є҆стества̀. тѣ́мъ веселѧ́щесѧ, тѧ̀ бцⷣе велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another [canon]. Ode 9. Heirmos:* A cornerstone was cut out without hands from thee, the unhewn mountain, O Virgin, even Christ, Who joined together the sundered natures. Therefore, rejoicing, we magnify thee, O Mother of God.

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Черто́гъ пречⷭ҇тыи сѐи, бг҃ороди́тельнице ꙗ҆ви́сѧ ра́ка твоѧ̀, чⷭ҇тнꙋ́ю твою̀ ри́зꙋ, дѣ́вственное же ѡ҆дѣѧ́нїе, и҆ невѣ́стническое, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆мꙋ́щи. и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ жи́зни сокро́вище соблюда́ющи.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* This most pure bridal chamber, O Birthgiver of God, has thy shrine been shown to be, having thine honored robe, a virginal and bridal garment, and guarding it as a treasure of life.

items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Хра́мъ и҆з̾ѡблича́ющїй, всѧ́ко нб҃ное бл҃гоᲂукраше́нїе дв҃ы, дне́сь вѣ́рнїи дости́гше, чꙋде́съ зарѧ́ми ꙗ҆́коже ѕвѣзда́ми сїѧ́емъ, и҆ ѡ҆зарѧ́емсѧ бл҃гтїю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Reaching today the temple which manifests all heavenly adornment of the Virgin, we, the faithful, shine with the beams of wonders as with stars, and are illumined with grace.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́мать ст҃ы́и тво́й по́ѧсъ, и҆ чⷭ҇тнꙋ́ю твою̀ ри́зꙋ бг҃ороди́тельнице, тво́й гра́дъ ꙗ҆́кѡ стѣ́нꙋ, и҆ ᲂу҆че́нїй бж҃твенныхъ соединенїе, и҆ правосла́вныхъ похвалꙋ̀, и҆ царе́й побѣди́телнаѧ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пое́мъ неизрече́ннꙋю сла́вꙋ, и҆ безчи́сленнꙋю твою̀ бл҃года́ть: ты́ бо є҆сѝ и҆сто́чникъ премꙋ́дрости, и҆з̾ негѡ́же сло́во всѣ̑мъ происхо́дитъ, чтꙋ́щымъ тѧ̀ пречⷭ҇таѧ, и҆ велича́ющымъ ржⷭ҇тво̀ твоѐ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* We sing of thine ineffable glory and thy boundless grace; for thou art the fountain of wisdom, from which the Word goes forth unto all who honor thee, O most pure one, and magnify thy childbearing.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣти́ленъ: Подо́бенъ: Свѣ́те неизмѣ́нне: Ѡ҆кропи́вшꙋю хрⷭ҇та̀ ри́зꙋ бг҃оѻтрокови́цы, и҆ бцⷣы мр҃і́и, дне́сь прїиди́те земноро́дні́и, почти́мъ пѣ́сньми, ꙗ҆́кѡ да благода́тїю сеѧ̀ при́снѡ ᲂу҆блажа́емсѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Exapostilarion, Podoben: "O Changeless Light" (Свѣ́те неизмѣ́нне):* Come, ye earthborn, today let us honor with hymns the robe of the maiden of God and Mother of God Mary, which sprinkled Christ, that by its grace we may ever be blessed.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4.* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Raised Up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Е҆ди́на и҆ є҆стество̀ и҆ вре́мѧ, ѡ҆бнови́ла є҆сѝ бг҃ома́ти: нетлѣ́нно бо твоѐ ржⷭ҇тво̀, нетлѣ́ннаѧ и҆ ри́за, є҆́юже гра́дъ тво́й покрыва́еши: є҆́юже ски́птри бл҃гоче́стїѧ содержи́ши.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou alone hast renewed both nature and time, O Mother of God; for incorrupt is thy childbearing, and incorrupt also is the robe wherewith thou coverest thy city, wherewith thou upholdest the scepters of piety.

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF JULY :: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises, stichera on 4.*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́ка содержа́щаѧ ри́зꙋ твою̀ пречⷭ҇таѧ, кївѡ́тъ ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїѧ рабѡ́мъ твои̑мъ, * и҆ сщ҃е́нное ѡ҆гражде́нїе, * и҆ сла́ва и҆ похвала̀, * и҆ и҆сцѣле́нїй и҆сто́чникъ * на всѧ́къ де́нь познава́етсѧ. * И҆дѣ́же дне́сь сщ҃еннѡ собра́вшесѧ, * воспѣва́емъ мнѡ́гаѧ твоѧ̑ твоѧ̑ вели́чїѧ, * и҆ чꙋде́съ пꙋчи́нꙋ. Два́жды И҆ мѣ́сто пресла́вно, * сїѧ́ломъ присносвѣ́телъ, * въ не́мже сокро́вище положи́сѧ, * честна́ѧ ри́за бг҃оѻтрокови́цы * благода́тїю: * пристꙋпи́те чл҃цы, * просвѣще́нїе и҆ ѡ҆чище́нїе, * и҆з̾ неѧ̀ проли́внѡ почерпи́те, * и҆ возопі́йте благода́рнымъ срⷣцемъ: * прест҃а́ѧ дв҃о благослови́мъ тѧ̀, * спаса́еми ржⷭ҇тво́мъ твои́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The shrine containing thy robe, O most pure one, is known every day by thy servants as an ark of sanctification, and a sacred defense, and glory and praise, and a fountain of healings. Where having sacredly gathered together today, we sing of thy many great wonders and the abyss of miracles. *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сщ҃е́нное положе́нїе ри́зы твоеѧ̀ влⷣчце, * пра́здникъ стѧжа́хомъ веселѧ́щеся, * ꙗ҆́кѡ гра́дꙋ твоемꙋ̀ дне́сь да́тисѧ сподо́била є҆сѝ: * сщ҃е́нное ѡ҆дѣѧ́нїе, * храни́лище некра́домо, * да́ръ чте́нъ, * неѡе́млемо бога́тство, * и҆сцѣле́нїй рѣка̀, * и҆спо́лнена дарова́нїй дꙋхо́вныхъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Most glorious is the place, ever radiant with beams, wherein by grace has been placed the treasure, the honored robe of the Maiden of God. Draw near, O men, and draw forth abundantly enlightenment and cleansing therefrom, and cry aloud with a thankful heart: O all-holy Virgin, we bless thee, being saved by thy childbearing!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Смы́слъ ѡ҆чи́стивше и҆ ᲂу҆́мъ, * со а҆́гглы и҆ мы̀ торжествꙋ́емъ, * свѣ́тлѡ начина́юще дв҃дскꙋю пѣ́снь, ѻ҆трокови́цѣ невѣ́стѣ всѣ́хъ цр҃ѧ̀ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а на́шегѡ: * воскрⷭ҇нѝ гдⷭ҇и, глаго́люще, въ поко́й тво́й, ты̀, и҆ кївѡ́тъ ст҃ы́ни твоеѧ̀: * ꙗ҆́кѡ бо пала́тꙋ краснꙋ̀ сїю̀ ᲂу҆краси́въ, * и҆ причтѐ ю҆ гра́дꙋ твоемꙋ̀ влⷣко, * стро́ити и҆ покрыва́ти, * ѿ сꙋпоста́тныхъ пога́нъ, * держа́вною си́лою твое́ю, моли́твами є҆ѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: The sacred deposition of thy robe, O Lady, we have acquired as a feast, rejoicing that today thou hast accounted thy city worthy to receive it: a sacred vestment, an unstolen treasury, an honored gift, an inalienable riches, a river of healings, full of spiritual gifts.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises, stichera on 4.*
items.office: At Matins, after the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: На лїтꙋргі́и, Блаже́нна, пѣ́снь, г҃, и҆ ѕ҃. Прокі́менъ, гла́съ, г҃: пѣ́снь бцⷣы: Вели́читъ дꙋша̀ моѧ̀ гдⷭ҇а: Стї́хъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ призрѣ̀ на смире́нїе рабы̀ своеѧ̀. А҆пⷭ҇лъ ко є҆вре́ємъ, зач., тк҃. А҆ллилꙋ́їа, гла́съ, и҆: Воскрⷭ҇нѝ гдⷭ҇и въ поко́й тво́й: Є҆ѵⷢлїе лꙋкѝ, зача́ло, нд: Прича́стенъ: Ча́шꙋ сп҃се́нїѧ прїимꙋ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having cleansed our senses and mind, we also keep festival with the angels, radiantly beginning the Davidic song unto the Maiden, the Bride of Christ the King of all, our God: "Arise, O Lord, into Thy rest, Thou and the ark of Thy sanctuary,"[^19] saying: for having adorned her as a beautiful palace, Thou didst reckon her unto Thy city, O Master, to guide and protect it from adversary heathens by Thy sovereign power, through her prayers.

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF JULY :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6.*
items.office: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ка́мень положи́сѧ краеꙋго́лный, * въ сїѡ́нѣ и҆збра́нъ, * и҆ недви́жимо ѡ҆снова́нїе: * на не́мже созда́шасѧ мꙋ́ченикъ полцы̀, * съ ни́миже побѣдоно́сецъ ѵ҆акі́нѳъ, * нб҃ною сїѧ́етъ свѣ́тлостїю. * Ѡ҆ неизрече́ннагѡ твое́гѡ млⷭ҇рдїѧ влⷣко: * и҆́мже хрⷭ҇тѐ * спасѝ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ млⷭ҇рдъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: A cornerstone has been laid, chosen in Zion, and an immovable foundation, upon which the ranks of martyrs were built, with whom the victor Hyacinth shines with heavenly brightness. O Thine ineffable compassion, O Master, through which, O Christ, save our souls, as Thou alone art compassionate!

items.office: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѐрпнымъ протека́ѧ є҆сѝ, * гра́дъ бж҃їй свѣ́тлыи, * ꙗ҆́коже ка́мень ка́мень бы́въ ѡ҆багри́нъ кро́вїю, * червлени́цею страда́нїѧ. * И҆ нн҃ѣ моли́сѧ ꙗ҆́вственнѣ, * ликꙋ́ѧ и҆ ра́дꙋѧсѧ. * Спаса́й моли́твами твои́ми, * твою̀ пресла́внꙋю, * и҆ сщ҃е́нную па́мѧть пра́зднꙋющыѧ пребл҃же́нне.
items.english_cohort_translation: Running as a stone of jacinth[^21] through the radiant city of God, having become a stone dyed red with blood, with the purple of suffering. And now pray clearly, dancing and rejoicing. Save by thy prayers those who celebrate thy most glorious and sacred memory, O all-blessed one!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆мѣ́ѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ мꙋ́чнкъ непобѣди́мый, * ко влⷣцѣ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ * дерзнове́нїе благопрїѧ́тно, * ꙗ҆́кѡ зако́ненъ страда́лецъ, * бл҃года́тно слы́шанїе ѻ҆́нагѡ, * мольба́ми не преста́й досточꙋ́дне, * па́мѧть твора́ вѣ́рнѡ пою́щихъ тѧ̀, * и҆ напа́стей си́хъ и҆з̾има́ѧ, и҆ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїа.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having, as an unconquerable martyr, acceptable boldness unto Christ the Master, as a lawful athlete, an advantageous hearing from Him, cease not, O right-honored one, to pray for those who faithfully sing thy memory, delivering them from these misfortunes and afflictions.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пло́ть ѿ крове́й твои́хъ прїе́мъ, * первовѣ́чный бг҃ъ, * тѧ̀ предста́тельницꙋ показа̀ * чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ чи́стаѧ. * Тѣ́мже и҆зба́ви рабы̑ твоѧ̑, * ѿ всѧ́кїѧ бѣды̀ и҆ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїа, * и҆ сѣте́й лꙋка́вагѡ врага̀. * И҆ сїѧ́нїа прича́ститисѧ сподо́би и҆збра́нныхъ, * всѧ̑ сла́вѧщыѧ и҆ покланѧ́ющыѧсѧ тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Taking flesh from thy blood, the pre-eternal God showed thee forth, O pure one, as an intercessor for men. Therefore deliver thy servants from every trouble and affliction, and from the snares of the crafty enemy; and account all who glorify and worship thee worthy to partake of the radiance of the chosen.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, д҃: Мꙋ́ченикъ тво́й гдⷭ҇и ѵ҆акі́нѳъ, во страда́нїи свое́мъ вѣне́цъ прїѧ́тъ нетлѣ́нный, ѿ тебѐ бг҃а на́шегѡ: и҆мѣ́ѧй бо крѣ́пость твою̀, мꙋчи́телей низложѝ, сокрꙋшѝ и҆ де́монѡвъ немощны́ѧ де́рзѡсти. Тогѡ̀ мл҃твами спасѝ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion, Tone 4:* Thy martyr, O Lord, Hyacinth, in his suffering received an incorruptible crown from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength, he cast down the torturers and crushed the powerless insolence of demons. By his prayers save our souls!

Pray Christ God to grant us great mercy!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃ественнагѡ є҆стества̀ не ѿлꙋ́чсѧ, пло́ть бы́въ во чре́вѣ твое́мъ: но бг҃ъ вочеловѣ́чисѧ и҆ пребы́сть, и҆́же по ржⷭ҇твѣ̀ мт҃рь тѧ̀ дв҃ꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ пре́жде рождества̀ сохрани́въ всенепоро́чнꙋ, є҆ди́нъ гдⷭ҇ь: того̀ прилѣ́жнѡ молѝ, дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_cohort_translation: Without parting from the divine nature, the only Lord became flesh in thy womb; but God became man and remained such, Who after childbearing preserved thee, His Mother, a Virgin all-blameless even as before childbearing: pray Him fervently to grant us great mercy!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Нескве́рнаѧ а҆́гница сло́ва, нетлѣ́ннаѧ дв҃а мт҃и, на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ зрѧ́щи повѣ́шена, и҆з̾ неѧ̀ без̾ болѣ́зни прозѧ́бшаго, мт҃рски подо́бнѡ рыда́ющи вопїѧ́ше: ᲂу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ ча́до моѐ, ка́кѡ стра́ждеши во́лею? хотѧ̀ и҆зба́вити ѿ страсте́й безче́стїа человѣ́ка.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion:* The undefiled ewe-lamb of the Word, the incorrupt Virgin Mother, seeing Him Who budded from her without travail hanging upon the Cross, maternally sobbing, cried aloud: Woe is me, my Child! How art Thou suffering willingly, desiring to deliver man from the passions of dishonor?

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ты̀ бг҃а возлюби́лъ є҆сѝ ѿ дꙋшѝ, да́же до кро́ве, ко грѣхꙋ̀ страда́лче бл҃же́нне сопроти́влѧѧсѧ, и҆ врагѝ ꙗ҆́вѣ ᲂу҆бива́ѧ. и҆ побѣ́дными ᲂу҆краша́емь вѣнцы̀, ᲂу҆се́рднѡ взыва́еши: сщ҃е́нницы бл҃гослови́те, лю́дїе превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst love God from thy soul, resisting sin even unto blood, O blessed athlete, and clearly slaying the enemies; and adorned with victory crowns, thou criest earnestly: Ye priests, bless; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Сло́во бж҃їе безнача́лное па́че сло́ва родила̀ є҆сѝ, на бл҃гоѡдѣѧ́нїе слове́снагѡ є҆стества̀, и҆́мже и҆збавлѧ́емсѧ тлетво́рнагѡ ᲂу҆мерщвле́нїѧ, и҆ животворѧ́щїй прїѧ́хомъ дх҃ъ: тѣ́мже тѧ̀ бцⷣꙋ и҆́стиннꙋю и҆ сꙋ́щꙋю сла́вимъ, дв҃о во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Beyond word hast thou given birth unto the unoriginate Word of God for the good adornment of rational nature, through Whom we are delivered from corrupting death and have received the life-creating Spirit; therefore as the true and real Mother of God we glorify thee, O Virgin, unto all ages.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Їрмо́съ: Тѧ̀ неискꙋсобра́чнꙋю мт҃рь бг҃а вы́шнѧгѡ: тѧ̀ па́че ᲂу҆ма̀ ро́ждшꙋю сло́вомъ вои́стиннꙋ бг҃а, вы́шшꙋю пречⷭ҇тыхъ си́лъ, немо́лчными славословле́нїи велича́емъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мл҃тива сотворѝ твои́ми моли́твами влⷣкꙋ, всѣ̑мъ вѣ́рнѡ пою́щымъ твоѐ непобѣди́мое страда́нїе, и҆́мже і҆́дѡльскꙋю ле́сть ᲂу҆праздни́лъ є҆сѝ, сло́во же бл҃гоче́стїа ᲂу҆ѧсни́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Make the Master merciful by thy prayers unto all who faithfully hymn thine unconquerable suffering, through which thou didst abolish idolatrous deceit and didst make clear the word of piety.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Видѣ́нїемъ прекра́сенъ, а҆́гглскимъ во́инствѡмъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ небе́снымъ ша́ромъ ѵ҆акі́нѳе ѡ҆багре́нъ кро́вїю, и҆́же по хрⷭ҇тѣ̀ и҆сповѣ́данїа и҆ вѣ́ры, и҆ вѣнце́мъ мꙋче́нїѧ ᲂу҆кра́шенъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Comely in appearance unto the angelic hosts, as with a heavenly sphere, O Hyacinth, dyed with the blood of confession and faith in Christ, and adorned with the crown of martyrdom.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6.*
items.office: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ве́сь бы́лъ є҆сѝ бж҃їе всесщ҃е́нно прїѧ́телище. тѣ́ло и҆ дꙋ́шꙋ ѡ҆ст҃и́лъ є҆сѝ неѡсла́бнымъ сопротивле́нїемъ, къ мꙋчи́телстѣй бра́ни, и҆ беззако́ннѣй бы́вши: тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѝ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou wast entirely an all-sacred receptacle of God; thou didst sanctify body and soul by unslackening resistance in the torturer's and lawless battle; therefore we all bless thee.

items.office: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆мертвѝ во мнѣ̀ влⷣчце є҆щѐ живꙋ́щїй грѣ́хъ: ѡ҆живѝ дꙋше́вное ᲂу҆мерщвле́нїе, дѣ́йствомъ и҆́стинныѧ жи́зни, ро́ждшїѧсѧ и҆з̾ ᲂу҆тро́бы твоеѧ̀, за неизрече́нное млⷭ҇се́рдїе, бл҃гоче́стнѡ тѧ̀ велича́ющихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Slay in me, O Lady, the sin that still lives; quicken the mortification of my soul by the operation of the true Life that was born of thy womb, for the sake of ineffable mercy, of those who piously magnify thee.

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF JULY :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Stichera of Saint Andrew, on 3.*
items.office: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́сти земны̑ѧ возненави́дѣвъ тѣлесе́, * чи́стымъ нра́вомъ и҆ просты́мъ срⷣцемъ, * гдⷭ҇ви присво́илсѧ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е мꙋ́дре. * И҆ бг҃одохнове́ненъ ѻ҆рга́нъ ᲂу҆тѣ́шителѧ показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * пѣ́нїе на́мъ воспѣ́въ сп҃си́телное.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having hated the bodily pleasures of earth, with pure conduct and a simple heart, thou didst join thyself unto the Lord, O wise father; and thou wast shown to be an inspired instrument of the Comforter, having sung for us a saving song.[^25]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Stichera of Saint Andrew, on 3.*
items.office: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гдⷭ҇ню мт҃рь ѡ҆брѣ́тъ, * винꙋ̀ вели́кихъ похва́лъ, * медото́чными словесы̀ воспѣ́лъ є҆сѝ а҆ндре́е, * сщ҃е́нныхъ а҆́плѡвъ, * и҆ мꙋ́ченикъ же бл҃же́нныхъ сосло́вїе, * съ ни́миже на́съ чтꙋ́щихъ тѧ̀ помина́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having found the Mother of the Lord, the cause of great praises, with honey-flowing words thou didst sing of her, O Andrew, and of the assembly of the sacred apostles and blessed martyrs; together with them remember us who honor thee.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Правосла́вїа тѧ̀ сто́лпъ ѻ҆́ч҃е зна́емъ, * ѡ҆́бразъ цѣломꙋ́дрїа, * и҆ кро́тости начерта́нїе. * И҆ бж҃е́ственна пѣснопи́сца, * хрⷭ҇товы цр҃кви просвѣща́юща, * сщ҃еннотаи́нниче а҆ндре́е: * тѣ́мже твоѐ пра́зднꙋемъ торжество̀.

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF JULY :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Other stichera of Saint Martha, on 3.*
items.office: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.section: Other stichera of Saint Martha, on 3.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Къ болѣ́зненномꙋ воздержа́нїю, * къ мꙋ́жескимъ боре́нїемъ, * проти́вꙋ врага̀ ѡ҆полче́нїю запе́ншагѡ є҆стество̀ человѣ́кѡвъ, * ѿлꙋчи́ласѧ є҆сѝ, * поще́нїи и҆ слеза́ми не пощадѣ́вши пло́ти, * любве́ ра́ди бж҃е́ственныѧ: * тѣ́мже подала̀ є҆сѝ бж҃твенныѧ подви́ги, * смири́вши ра́зꙋмъ сопротивобо́рца, * ма́рѳо чтна́ѧ и҆ пресла́внаѧ. Два́жды.
items.english_cohort_translation: Unto painful abstinence, unto manly struggles, unto warfare against the enemy who tripped up human nature, thou didst separate thyself, not sparing the flesh through fasts and tears for the sake of divine love; therefore thou didst accomplish divine ascetical struggles, having humbled the mind of the adversary, O honored and most glorious Martha! *(Twice)*

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Other stichera of Saint Martha, on 3.*
items.office: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.section: Other stichera of Saint Martha, on 3.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Возгнꙋша́ласѧ є҆сѝ вре́менныхъ, * и҆ тлѣ́нныхъ любвѐ ѡ҆бѣ́гла є҆сѝ: * и҆ жре́бїй возжелѣ́ла є҆сѝ нб҃ныи, * пра́веднымъ досто́йный вѣчнꙋющїй, * нетлѣ́нный чи́стаѧ, * и҆ жи́знь непреста́ннꙋю. * Тѣ́мже вѣ́рою твою̀ свѣ́тлꙋю и҆ свѣтоно́снꙋю соверша́юще па́мѧть, * пѣ́сньми бж҃е́ственными почита́емъ, * ма́рѳо сла́внаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst loathe temporal things, and didst flee from the love of corruptible things; and thou didst desire the heavenly lot, eternal and worthy of the righteous, incorrupt, O pure one, and unceasing life. Therefore in faith performing thy radiant and light-bearing memory, we honor thee with divine hymns, O glorious Martha!

items.section: Other stichera of Saint Martha, on 3.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дꙋхо́вною благода́тїю, * ѿє́млеши недꙋ́ги, * ѿгонѧ́еши дꙋ́хи лꙋка̑выѧ, * и҆ цѣли́ши стра̑сти ма́рѳо всесла́внаѧ, * и҆ просвѣща́еши вѣ́рнымъ блиста́нїи чꙋде́съ твои́хъ. * Тѣ́мже дне́сь гла́сы немо́лчными, * воспѣва́емъ свѣ́тлꙋю и҆ свѣтоно́снꙋю, * и҆ досточꙋ́днꙋю па́мѧть твою̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: By spiritual grace thou takest away diseases, thou drivest away evil spirits, and thou healest passions, O all-glorious Martha, and thou enlightenest the faithful with the flashings of thy wonders. Therefore today with unceasing voices we sing of thy radiant, light-bearing, and right-marvelous memory.

items.section: Other stichera of Saint Martha, on 3.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆́гница и҆ па́стырѧ тѧ̀, * на дре́вѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ, * а҆́гница ро́ждшаѧ рыда́ше, * и҆ ма́терски вѣща́ше: * сн҃е возжелѣ́нне, * ка́кѡ на дре́вѣ крⷭ҇тнѣмъ повѣ́шенъ є҆сѝ долготерпѣли́ве? * ка́кѡ рꙋ́цѣ и҆ но́зѣ твоѝ сло́ве * пригвозди́шасѧ ѿ беззако́нныхъ, * и҆ кро́вь твою̀ и҆здїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ влⷣко?
items.english_cohort_translation: Seeing Thee upon the Tree, her Lamb and Shepherd, the Ewe-lamb that bare Thee wept and maternally cried aloud: O my beloved Son, how art Thou suspended upon the Tree of the Cross, O Long-suffering One? How were Thy hands and feet, O Word, pierced with nails by the lawless, and how hast Thou poured out Thy blood, O Master?

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF JULY :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha of the Octoechos.*
items.office: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.section: At the Aposticha of the Octoechos.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мона́хѡвъ мно́жества, * наста́вника тѧ̀ почита́емъ ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ а҆ндре́е: * твое́ю бо стезѐю вои́стиннꙋ пра́вѡ ходи́ти позна́хомъ. * Блаже́нъ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ рабо́тавъ, * и҆ вра́жїю ѡ҆бличи́лъ є҆сѝ си́лꙋ, * а҆́гглѡвъ собесѣ́дниче, * прпⷣбныхъ соприча́стниче и҆ пра́ведныхъ. * Съ ни́миже моли́сѧ гдⷭ҇ви, поми́ловатисѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The multitudes of monastics honor thee as an instructor, O our father Andrew; for by thy path we have truly learned to walk uprightly. Blessed art thou who didst labor for Christ, and didst refute the power of the enemy, O converser with the angels, companion of the venerable and the righteous; with them pray unto the Lord that our souls may be saved!

items.section: At the Aposticha of the Octoechos.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ю҆́ница нескве́рнаѧ, * ю҆нца̀ ви́дѧщи на дре́вѣ * пригвожда́ема во́лею: * рыда́ющи жа́лостнѣ, * ᲂу҆вы́ мнѣ̀, вопїѧ́ше, * люби́мѣйшее ча́до: * что̀ тѝ со́нмъ воздадѐ безблагода́тный є҆вре́йскїй? * хотѧ̀ мѧ̀ ѡ҆безча́дствовати * ѿ тебѐ вселюбе́зне.
items.english_cohort_translation: The undefiled heifer, seeing the Calf nailed willingly upon the Tree, weeping piteously, cried aloud: Woe is me, most beloved Child! What hath the thankless Jewish council rendered unto Thee, desiring to bereave me of Thee, O All-beloved?

items.section: At the Aposticha of the Octoechos.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, д҃: Пра́вило вѣ́ры, и҆ ѡ҆́бразъ кро́тости, воздержа́нїѧ ᲂу҆чи́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ тѧ̀ ста́дꙋ твоемꙋ̀, ꙗ҆́же веще́й и҆́стина. Сегѡ̀ ра́ди стѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ смире́нїемъ высо́каѧ, нището́ю бога̑таѧ, ѻ҆́ч҃е а҆ндре́е, молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion, Tone 4:* The truth of things revealed thee unto thy flock as a rule of faith, an image of meekness, and a teacher of temperance; therefore through humility thou hast acquired the high things, and through poverty the rich things: O father Andrew, pray Christ God that our souls may be saved!

items.section: At the Aposticha of the Octoechos.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ тебѣ̀ ма́ти и҆звѣ́стнѡ спасе́сѧ, є҆́же по ѡ҆́бразꙋ: прїи́мши бо крⷭ҇тъ, послѣ́довала є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀, и҆ дѣ́ющи ᲂу҆чи́ла є҆сѝ, презира́ти ᲂу҆́бѡ пло́ть, прехо́дитъ бо: прилѣжа́ти же ѡ҆ дꙋшѝ ве́щи безсме́ртнѣй. Тѣ́мже и҆ со а҆́гглы сра́дꙋетсѧ преподо́бнаѧ ма́рѳо дꙋ́хъ тво́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another Troparion, Tone 8:* In thee, O mother, was preserved that which is according to the image; for taking up the cross, thou didst follow Christ, and by thine deeds didst teach us to overlook the flesh, for it passes away, but to care for the soul, a thing immortal: therefore thy spirit rejoices together with the angels, O venerable Martha!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зако́нꙋ бг҃опи́санномꙋ мꙋ́дрѣ повинꙋ́ѧсѧ, тѣле́сныѧ стра̑сти по́стнически ᲂу҆мертви́лъ є҆сѝ. ᲂу҆́мъ же возвы́силъ є҆сѝ крѣ́пкимъ твои́мъ жела́нїемъ, поѧ̀ пѣ́сни бж҃їѧ всемꙋ́дре.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Распала́ема бж҃е́ственнымъ рве́нїемъ, бг҃омꙋ́жнѡ пожи́вши, родила̀ є҆сѝ свѣти́лника вѣ̑рнымъ и҆ забра́ло, втора́го самꙋи́ла, и҆ пꙋсты́ни кра́сное воспита́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Inflamed with divine zeal, having lived in a godly and valiant manner, thou didst give birth unto a luminary for the faithful and a bulwark, a second Samuel,[^29] and the fair fosterling of the wilderness.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Произзябе́нїе ꙗ҆ви́сѧ воздержа́нїѧ, возсїѧ́вши на́мъ со́лнце многосвѣ́тлое, и҆ вели́ка цѣле́бника, премꙋ́драго сѷмеѡ́на, и҆ восто́чнѣй странѣ̀, предста́телѧ же и҆ стѣ́нꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* An offspring of abstinence wast thou shown to be, having shone forth upon us a sun of many lights and a great healer, the all-wise Symeon, and for the eastern land a protector and a wall.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Землѝ и҆сча́дїе бцⷣе, сы́нове бы́вше бж҃їи бл҃гтїю бж҃е́ственною, и҆ неизрече́ннымъ ржⷭ҇тво́мъ твои́мъ. Пое́мъ тѧ̀ прилѣ́жнѡ, є҆ди́нꙋ вино́внꙋ сꙋ́щагѡ спасе́нїа.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Offspring of the earth, O Mother of God, having become children of God through divine grace and through thine ineffable childbearing, we diligently hymn thee, the only cause of our salvation.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Їрмо́съ: Ѡ҆дрꙋзи́вый на ничесо́мже зе́млю повелѣ́нїемъ твои́мъ, и҆ повѣ́сивый неѡдержи́мѡ тѧготѣ́ющꙋю, на недви́жимѣмъ хрⷭ҇тѐ ка́мени, за́повѣдей твои́хъ, цр҃ковь твою̀ ᲂу҆твердѝ є҆ди́не бла́же, и҆ чл҃вѣколю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Thou Who didst establish the earth upon nothing by Thy command, and didst suspend its weight unrestrained, on the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, establish Thy Church, O only Good and Lover of mankind![^30]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆пра́вилъ є҆сѝ добродѣ́телїю, житїѐ твоѐ прпⷣбне: и҆ бж҃твеннымъ жела́нїемъ бг҃ꙋ соедини́лсѧ, ѻ҆рга́нъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ слове́сенъ, всю̀ вселе́ннꙋю ᲂу҆ѧснѧ́ѧ пѣ́снми, бж҃твеннаѧ сокро́вища почерпа́ѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst guide thy life by virtue, O venerable one; and united unto God by divine desire, thou wast shown to be an articulate instrument, enlightening the whole inhabited earth with hymns, drawing from divine treasures.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Премꙋ́дрости нб҃ныѧ бы́лъ є҆сѝ и҆спо́лненъ, дꙋше́внаѧ бо ᲂу҆ста̀ разшири́въ преподо́бне, всю̀ прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́вѣ зарю̀ свѣтоно́снꙋю трїсо́лнечныѧ свѣ́тлости, ꙗ҆́кѡ сщ҃еннодѣ́йственникъ сщ҃е́ненъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou wast filled with heavenly wisdom; for having opened wide the mouth of thy soul, O venerable father, thou didst openly receive the light-bearing radiance of the thrice-radiant brightness, as a sacred priest.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆тверди́въ дꙋше́вныѧ си́лы твоѧ̑ преподо́бне, и҆ пло́ть ᲂу҆держа́въ воздержа́нїемъ, бы́лъ є҆сѝ всѣ̑мъ пресвѣ́тлаѧ ѕвѣзда̀, ᲂу҆краша́ѧ цр҃ковь правосла́вными твои́ми ᲂу҆че́нїи, и҆ пѣ́сненными пѣ́нїи.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having strengthened the powers of thy soul, O venerable one, and restrained the flesh by temperance, thou wast an all-radiant star unto all, adorning the Church with thine Orthodox teachings and hymnic songs.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆зба́вити мѧ̀ стра́стнагѡ плѣне́нїѧ, ны́нѣ молю́ тѧ мт҃и бж҃їа всенепоро́чнаѧ, и҆ грѣхо́вныѧ ꙗ҆́звы всѧ̑ ѡ҆чи́стити, грѣ́хъ взе́млющаго мі́ра пресла́внѡ ро́ждшаѧ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́нъ. Їрмо́съ: Нѣ́сть ст҃ъ ꙗ҆́кѡ гдⷭ҇ь, и҆ нѣ́сть пра́веденъ ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ на́шъ, є҆го́же пое́тъ всѧ̀ тва́рь: нѣ́сть пра́веденъ па́че тебѐ гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: There is none holy as the Lord, and none righteous as our God, of Whom all creation sings: there is none righteous besides Thee, O Lord![^31]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пло́дъ пречⷭ҇тенъ и҆з̾ ᲂу҆тро́бы твоеѧ̀ бл҃цѣ прине́сши, же́ртвꙋ соверше́ннꙋ сама̀ себѐ воздержа́нїѧ ѻ҆гне́мъ принесла̀ є҆сѝ ма́рѳо, пѣ́снословѧщи є҆го̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having offered unto the Master an all-honored fruit from thy womb, thou didst offer thyself as a perfect sacrifice by the fire of temperance, O Martha, hymning Him.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Же́ртвꙋ благопрїѧ́тнꙋ, и҆ присноживо́тнꙋ, хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ твое́мꙋ принесла̀ є҆сѝ, прозѧ́бшаго и҆з̾ ложе́снъ твои́хъ, бг҃оно́сице преподо́бнаѧ, вѣ́рныхъ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе, и҆ стѣ́нꙋ и҆ забра́ло.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* An acceptable and ever-living sacrifice didst thou offer unto thy Christ, him who budded forth from thy womb, O God-bearing and venerable mother, confirmation of the faithful, and a wall and a bulwark.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Къ высотѣ̀ небе́снѣй впери́ла є҆сѝ дꙋ́шꙋ съ тѣ́ломъ, и҆ была̀ є҆сѝ є҆диножи́телница мꙋ́дрымъ дѣ́вамъ, и҆ бж҃твенное и҆зѡбраже́нїе, вѣ́рою притека́ющымъ къ бг҃ꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Unto heavenly height thou didst wing thy soul together with the body, and thou wast a fellow-dweller with the wise virgins, and a divine image unto those who flee unto God in faith.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: На ка́мени пречⷭ҇таѧ ᲂу҆пова́нїѧ моегѡ̀, дꙋ́ши моеѧ̀ восхо́ды положѝ, недви́жимь при́снѡ пребыва́ѧ, хвалю̀ и҆ сла́влю тѧ̀, є҆ди́нꙋ застꙋ́пницꙋ мою̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Upon the rock of my hope, O most pure one, establish the ascents of my soul; that remaining ever unshaken, I may praise and glorify thee, my only protectress.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ ма́рѳы, гла́съ, в҃. Подо́бенъ: Въ моли́твахъ: Въ моли́твахъ гдⷭ҇ви предстоѧ́щи, пречⷭ҇тѣй дв҃ѣ бцⷣѣ, пѣ́нїе и҆ хвалы̀ приносѧ́щи ма́рѳо честна́ѧ, породи́ла є҆сѝ сщ҃е́нное ѻ҆троча̀, сѷмеѡ́на преди́внаго, свѣти́лника всемї́рнаго: съ ни́мже молѝ при́снѡ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of Saint Martha, Tone 2, Podoben: "In Prayers" (Въ моли́твахъ):* Standing in prayers before the Lord, offering songs and praises unto the most pure Virgin Mother of God, O honored Martha, thou didst bear a sacred child, the most marvelous Symeon, a universal luminary: with him pray ever for all of us!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Then the Sessional Hymn of Saint Andrew, Tone 4, Podoben: "Speedily Anticipate" (Ско́рѡ предварѝ):*
items.office: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes, Ode 3 and 6
items.section: Then the Sessional Hymn of Saint Andrew, Tone 4, Podoben: "Speedily Anticipate" (Ско́рѡ предварѝ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ка́менїемъ словесы̀ твои́ми, цр҃ко́вный премꙋ́дре ᲂу҆краси́въ вѣне́цъ, сщ҃еннодѣ́йственникъ сщ҃е́ненъ а҆ндре́е бы́лъ є҆сѝ. Тѣ́мже по мно́гихъ въ житїѝ трꙋдѣ́хъ, прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ неста́рѣемое црⷭ҇тво и҆ сла́вꙋ: въ не́мже помина́ющихъ тѧ̀ ѻ҆́ч҃е помина́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: As with precious stones, with thy words, O all-wise one, having adorned the crown of the Church, thou wast a sacred priest, O Andrew; therefore after many labors in this life, thou hast received an ageless kingdom and glory: therein remember, O father, those who remember thee!
